verdict: Organic profiles are your only active signal; paid channels remain off.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals — the last 28 days produced 371 combined Google Business Profile actions (calls, direction requests, and web clicks) with zero paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement declined sharply in the final week, with Advance Grinding down 72% and O'Hare down 70% week-over-week, and all three profiles recorded zero actions on each of the last three days of the period. The Web and SEO fix and the contact list needed to activate outreach are both being resolved now, with lapsed email sequences targeted for launch by September 30. Once those blockers clear, cold outreach and organic search will have the foundation to contribute alongside the map profiles.
